title: Frobenius Alexander quandles, knot colorings, and isogeny classes of abelian varieties over finite fields
summary: We introduce the notion of Frobenius Alexander quandles associated with abelian varieties over finite fields, and study them from both knot-theoretic and arithmetic viewpoints. We determine exactly for which rational primes a knot admits a nonconstant coloring by these quandles, in terms of the resultant of its Alexander polynomial and the Frobenius characteristic polynomial of the abelian variety.
